why: Analysis 2 stays closer to the key by keeping the superstore operating system as the engine, benchmarking profit per store against Rival B, and explicitly warning against the silver-bullet moves the key names (overnight commission rip-out, mass replacement of experienced counselors, a rebrand). Analysis 1 is slightly more careful in flagging missing data and assumptions, but it concedes the core race to Rival B and its verdict is less tight.
